props.value: Test profile for tools/trp_oscal.py. It declares mappings from its requirements to controls of NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 and the NIST AI RMF in x_oscal, so its export carries an OSCAL mapping collection. The threshold values and the mappings are illustrative.
